name: consumer-law
description: Finnish consumer law (kuluttajansuojalaki 38/1978): the consumer's rights where goods or a service are defective, the right of withdrawal and the information duties in off-premises and distance selling, unfair marketing, and the resolution of consumer disputes (the Consumer Disputes Board 8/2007 and KKV 661/2012) together with good collection practice for a consumer debt (513/1999).
